value.rationale: An elementary one-out edge refresh is a canonical perturbation of a finite random dynamical system. The rare n^-1/2 component-count change, macroscopic conditional affected basin, and Rayleigh cycle mark jointly characterize robustness and failure severity; the beta–Rayleigh coupling is materially richer than a marginal size or mean computation.
